app.tagline: Verified boot sticks – no ISO hunting
forge.hint.need_variant: Choose a distribution and variant first.
catalog.fallback.cache: Online catalog unreachable – using the last saved version.
catalog.fallback.bundled: Online catalog unreachable – using the built-in version, which may be outdated.
error.server: The server responded with an error.
error.no_match: The latest version could not be found. The download page has probably changed – the catalog needs an update.
error.not_supported_yet: Will be supported in a later version.
error.insecure: The source is not secure (no HTTPS) and was blocked.
error.catalog_not_loaded: The catalog has not been loaded yet.
error.unknown_variant: This variant does not exist in the catalog.
prepare.from_cache: Already downloaded – re-verified, no download needed.
prepare.assurance.signed: Authenticity confirmed: checksum and vendor signature match.
prepare.assurance.checksum: Checksum matches. The vendor does not provide a signature.
prepare.assurance.weak: Only MD5 checked – detects transfer errors but not tampering.
prepare.cancelled: Cancelled. The partial download is kept and will be resumed next time.
error.checksum_mismatch: Checksum mismatch! The file is corrupted or tampered with and has been deleted.
error.signature_invalid: The vendor signature is invalid. For safety nothing was downloaded or the file was deleted.
error.checksum_missing: No checksum exists for this file. Nothing is used without a checksum.
usb.title: Choose USB drive
usb.intro: Only USB drives are shown. System and internal disks are always blocked.
usb.empty: No USB drive found. Plug one in – the list updates automatically.
usb.show_hdds_hint: Careful: these often hold backups. Only enable if you really want to write to a hard disk.
reject.too_large: Too large for a USB stick
confirm.title: All data will be erased
confirm.text: SealFlash overwrites the entire drive. Everything stored on it will be lost irrevocably.
confirm.type: Type the drive's name to confirm:
forge.done_text: {size} written and confirmed by reading back. You can unplug the drive now.
error.confirm_mismatch: The typed name does not match – nothing was changed.
error.drive_changed: The drive changed (unplugged or a different one plugged in). For safety nothing was written.
error.image_mismatch: The image no longer matches its checksum. Nothing was written.
error.image_changed: The image was modified while writing. The drive was made unusable.
error.too_small: The drive is too small for this image.
error.readback_mismatch: Reading back returned different data. The drive is probably defective or counterfeit (reports more capacity than it has).
error.drive_busy: The drive is still in use. Close all windows and programs that access it.
error.not_elevated: SealFlash needs administrator rights to write. Start it via right-click → “Run as administrator”.
error.auth_cancelled: Authentication was cancelled – nothing was changed.
error.helper_missing: The helper program for writing is missing (incomplete installation).
error.flash_cancelled: Cancelled. The drive is now empty and must be written again.
forge.windows_format_hint: Windows may now ask whether to format the drive – please click “Cancel”! Windows just can't read the file system on the drive; formatting would erase it again.
local.own.title: Own image
local.own.subtitle: ISO or IMG of your own
local.own.intro: For anything not in the catalogue: an ISO or IMG file you downloaded yourself. Linux ISOs are written 1:1, Windows installation ISOs are detected automatically.
local.own.heading: File and checksum
local.own.hash: Checksum from the vendor (SHA-256 or SHA-512)
local.own.hash_hint: Copy the value from the vendor's download page. Without a matching checksum SealFlash writes nothing – this catches corrupted or tampered files.
local.win.step1_hint: On the page, under “Download Disk Image (ISO)”, pick the edition and language. Microsoft only allows this download in a browser.
local.win.step2_hint: SealFlash verifies the file against the checksums Microsoft publishes on the same page.
local.ok_vendor: Verified – the checksum is on Microsoft's list.
local.no_boot_record: The image has no boot sector. Written 1:1, a PC will probably not boot from it.
forge.hint.need_file: Choose a file and let it be verified first.
error.invalid_hash: That is not a valid checksum (expected SHA-256 or SHA-512 in hex).
error.not_windows_media: This is not Windows installation media. Use “Own image” for other images.
error.not_verified: The file has not been verified yet.
error.wimlib_missing: Windows images over 4 GB need the wimlib-imagex program (Linux: install the “wimtools” package).
error.not_on_vendor_list: This file is not on Microsoft's checksum list. It is corrupted, modified or not an original ISO – download it again from the download page.
cache.label: Cache
cache.title: Downloaded images
cache.text: {n} image(s), {size} in total. They are kept so that a second drive needs no new download.
cache.partial: Plus {n} unfinished download(s) that would be resumed next time.
error.no_space: Not enough disk space for the download. Clear the cache (bottom right) or free up space on the drive.
catalog.fallback.incompatible: The online catalogue does not match this SealFlash version – the saved or built-in list is used. Please update SealFlash.
